_comment: Single source of truth for the product brand and provider policy. Edit this file to rename the product, then run `npm run brand:sync` to refresh the static files that cannot read it at runtime (package.json names, CLI bin).
name: FlagshipRouter
tagline: Free AI models for every coding tool
description: A local AI gateway that connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, OpenCode and other coding tools to free AI models through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

models._comment: Public model renames. Clients list and call `id` (or `name`); the router calls `targets` (provider-alias/model) in order behind the scenes — when one is unavailable, the next answers — and reports `id` back in every response. hideTarget keeps the targets out of /v1/models and the dashboard catalog.

providers._comment: freeOnly limits the dashboard, management APIs and connection store to free providers: registry entries whose category is listed here, plus entries flagged hasFree when includeHasFree is true. include/exclude take provider ids. customEndpoints enables user-defined OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
